notes.title: Bird Flocks
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1483110/Alien_AI/]Alien AI[/url] has got an update!

We have added bird flocks in Alien AI. Look towards the sky in the first part of the game when drinking water, and you will see sparrow bird flocks in the sky. We think more wildlife is important for giving the player a more realistic feel and experience. We plan to expand on this by improving the experience with more wildlife carefully placed in the game. We have previously added deer in the game that runs away when approaching them. We think the combination of deer and bird flocks significantly enhances the overall experience of Alien AI.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39215637/19be420776cec56d5d4c72b64791a99cb9d24ffb.jpg[/img]

We hope to see you in the post-apocalypse Alien AI world!

Trailer video:
https://youtube.com/watch?v=jQF0EjTlcSE

notes.title: The Cabin
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1483110/Alien_AI/]Alien AI[/url] has got an update!

In the latter half of Alien AI, we have now added a cabin in the forest. A lost operative is found there. It is a difficult moment for the commander who knew the operative. The operative has kept a journal that can be found on the table in the cabin.

notes.title: Military Camps
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1483110/Alien_AI/]Alien AI[/url] has got an update!

There are now two military camps, a small and a large camp, that must be infiltrated and items gathered. These camps are the remnants of the failed forgotten war against the AI when it took over the World. The camps have items though that will be necessary in our mission.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39215637/71612d38ba8ce2199f9fb9169bf6ff4fe29a0001.jpg[/img]

We have added crashed helicopters around in several places. The helicopters are casualties of the drone swarm attacks that occurred during the war.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39215637/9299e60ddfc0776686def5fd116cbc457a470d77.jpg[/img]

The first city was a bit too difficult. We have improved this by moving some of the collectible items to the military camps. We have also improved the HUD symbols so that it is easier to see what is items and what is food/water/health. There is also one less drone in the first city now in normal difficulty mode. Autosave has been added at specific spots, so you will not risk loosing a lot of progress. Messages and voice have been improved.

We hope to see you in the post-apocalypse Alien AI world!

Update video:
https://youtube.com/watch?v=uW5SGE7pt08

Trailer video:
https://youtube.com/watch?v=jQF0EjTlcSE

notes.title: Satellite Dish
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1483110/Alien_AI/]Alien AI[/url] has got an update!

A satellite dish has been added to the second half of the game. We thought it would make a nice addition to the post-apocalyptic experience. The priority of the Alien AI at the advent of the take-over of the world was to disable communication. Antennas like these were all destroyed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39215637/d1d59917bf3958810fa297e3f006804ae4d94cd5.jpg[/img]

We have added deer throughout the world. With no humans around, animal life has flourished. You will find deer eating grass. They will run away when you get close to them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39215637/04bb39bbff964f62da621f84a728ae023c77b0dd.jpg[/img]

The start part of the game was a little bit quick earlier, so several player lost key information. We have slowed the start down a bit.

We have added a lot more voice acting in the latter part of the game. We hope you enjoy the interesting perceptions of the commander of what has happened.

A difficulty option has been added. You can now choose between easy, normal and hard mode.

We hope to see you in the post-apocalypse Alien AI world!

Trailer video:
https://youtube.com/watch?v=jQF0EjTlcSE

notes.title: Difficulty
notes.notes: We have added a difficulty option. You can now choose from easy, normal or hard. We have also added a bit more food in various places.

notes.title: Bigger City
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1483110/Alien_AI/]Alien AI[/url] has got an update!

We have extended the first city quite a bit and added more drones. When finished with collecting all the items in the city, you now have to walk to another part of the city that is even more overgrown than the main part of the city. We have added more drones in this extended part to increase the challenge a bit more for surviving the city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39215637/f3c8b20f4461aeb4d4083064da29b2e0d90859d0.jpg[/img]

The outtro video clip has been improved significantly. There is now a fascinating ending to the game that will make your mind spin.. We cannot say anything more here since we do not want go give any spoilers.

We have improved the drinking animation for the character. Some people have asked how it is possible to drink water when the world seems to be toxic. The explanation we now give by voice is that the running water is safe to drink when using the drinking filter in the suit. There is a drinking tube in the suit now for drinking from streams, etc.

The character walking physics have been improved to more easily walk across rubble, not get stuck too easily on stuff, etc. Also, some buildings that were impossible to enter have been blocked off.

We have added an "Invert Y" setting in the options. Some users have requested this feature. If you turn on the Invert Y option, the Y-axis of the mouse or other input device will be inverted.

We hope to see you in the post-apocalypse Alien AI world!

Trailer video:
https://youtube.com/watch?v=jQF0EjTlcSE

notes.title: Achievements
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1483110/Alien_AI/]Alien AI[/url] has got an update!

Alien AI now supports achievements. Achievements track your progress through the game, and can be seen by your friends and others. We have added 12 achievements to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39215637/1d53b09894a5a523f796b65f4225870f08bf37a9.png[/img]

Trailer video:
https://youtube.com/watch?v=jQF0EjTlcSE

notes.title: Added more voice acting
notes.notes: We have added more voice acting. After visiting the town, we added voice acting that go into the origin of the creatures.
